sources.supports: Ordinary Clotty fire immunity and Grilled transformation have a flooded-room exception, which permits normal killing rather than only suppressing the transformation.

Random hopping and close-range pursuit; flaming form has greater acquisition range and longer/faster hops. Eligible flame contact transforms a normal Hopper. Flaming Hopper still takes burning-status damage. Source Burning Basement replacement is 60%, not implemented here.
Repentance flames transform and strengthen Hoppers/Clotties, without damaging those reactive monsters. This motivates a flame-contact channel distinct from burning damage.
Hopper contact with a Hot Bomb transforms it into Flaming Hopper. The corresponding item producer is not implemented by this fire batch.
Exact tuples 15.0.0,15.3.0,29.0.0,54.0.0. All four source collisionRadius values are 13; Clotty/Grilled baseHP 15/20 and Hopper/Flaming baseHP 10/20 are reference values, not DeathWard HP.

implemented: External flame/burning multipliers, dry-only condition, target/trigger and health policy.
In-place identity/team/owner/stun-preserving transformation without rewards; triggering hit uses original rule once.
Real bounded fire exposure, typed projectile hits, cover/height checks, lifecycle and shared per-target contact cooldown.
Flooded room gameplay flag disables dry-only transformation/immunity; flag persists during room re-entry.
Flame visuals follow the fire combat plane, including above cover.
adaptations: Fractional HP retention and scaled maxHP are explicit local policy; exact native transformation HP retention is unverified.
Grilled DW collision radius changed from .65 to .6 to match equal source radius and permit a compatible in-place body.
Existing DW HP 80/96 for Clotty/Grilled and 48/64 for Hopper/Flaming retained; no source HP/stageHP conversion acceptance.
Shared .5-second fire contact cooldown and vertical reach are DeathWard tuning.
Grilled burning immunity and flooded inheritance use a provisional family interpretation; direct verification remains required.
not_implemented: Timed burning status, Fire Mind/Red Candle/Hot Bombs item producers and Flush.
Flooded room art/generation and complete ordinary environment routes; rivers retain dry banks and do not imply a room-wide flooded flag.
Faithful Hopper hop acquisition/range/airborne rock/pit behavior and 60% Burning Basement replacement.
I.Blob rare replacement and complete family stage approval.
Full item/champion/status/team parity, native numeric conversions and all acceptance gates.
